experiences.title: Drive a trained duck
experiences.scope: Real frozen PPO, bounded command sliders, standing/reset and failed-pose hold; no downloadable checkpoint bundle is published.

experiences.title: First fresh PPO attempt
experiences.scope: Actual fresh 128-environment/50-iteration PPO run, realized counters and native recorded failed-policy replay, with a working one-run Chrome investigator capture. The longer walking policy remains a separate run; public movie/recording archive URLs are pending.

experiences.title: Puppet duck
experiences.scope: Real Newton/BAM joint sliders, supported/free base, pause/step/restore/reset; native panel image remains.

experiences.title: Observation detective
experiences.scope: Named actor/critic features, physical raw telemetry and independent display freeze; gravity arrow remains.

experiences.title: Reward workshop
experiences.scope: Working native controls share their callback with the recorded-state capture: 14 active weights, tracking width, playback and save request. Actual mouse events, unchanged source motion, exported overrides, real one-factor retraining and independent policy ghosts are recorded.

experiences.title: Training investigator
experiences.scope: Interactive budget calculator, actual TensorBoard curves, frozen plan download with execution-time contract checks.

experiences.title: Reality-gap sandbox
experiences.scope: Native effects, latched apply, matched starts/ghosts, bounded supported reversal with amplitude/pause/single-step controls, actual 5 ms requested/delayed targets and servo/play response, and uniquely matched actor-velocity age. In-process retry limitations are recorded.

experiences.title: Explore incoming workflows
experiences.scope: Delegated Duck adaptations integrated. FlashSAC and teacher/replay warm-start SuperMimic have measured qualification/export evidence. Pure from-scratch SuperMimic remains unqualified; no rough terrain/recovery scope.
